artifacts.rights_basis: The English volume was published in 1900 and is in the United States public domain by publication date. Guéranger died in 1875 and the named translator, Laurence Shepherd, died in 1885. The Internet Archive/Google scan is a mechanical facsimile of that public-domain printing; no separate creative copyright claim is relied upon.

edition.title: The Liturgical Year: Time after Pentecost, Volume II

passages.context: Guéranger's direct theological reception of the Tenth Sunday after Pentecost Postcommunion, printed immediately after the Communion antiphon and immediately before the Latin and English Postcommunion on page 271. Read from PDF page 292 rendered at 160 dpi and visually checked against the hashed facsimile. It attributes sacramental repair and the preservation and increase of spiritual treasure to continuing divine aid; it does not establish the prayer's lexical meaning, authorship, date, or original calendar assignment.
passages.notes: Printed p. 271; Internet Archive leaf n303. Transcription preserves the printing's wording and punctuation but regularizes line-end word division. This passage is lawful to quote as public-domain text; consumers should keep Guéranger's fuller theology attributed to him.

work.author: Prosper Guéranger
work.description: Guéranger's historical and theological commentary on the cycle of the Roman liturgical year. English editions translate the original French work; their interpretive comments are reception witnesses rather than promulgating liturgical sources.
